app.name: Overturn
app.short_description: QA for AI-drafted replies: untouched rate, fixes by reason, and a test before every model change.
app.long_description: Your agents already review every AI-drafted reply before it goes out. Overturn records what the AI wrote, what the agent sent and why it changed, with a one-click reason, whichever tool drafted the reply. You get the untouched rate and the fixes by reason, by team and by week (never a per-agent rate), and every fix replays as a regression test before the next model or prompt change. The app reads a ticket only after an AI draft appears in its reply box.
app.installation_instructions: Create a project API key in Overturn (Settings → API keys) and paste it into the app settings. Set the workflow name (one suite per workflow). Optionally list the custom fields that carry the decision as id:label pairs, and a scope tag to limit which tickets are watched.
